sequence_description: Attempt to inject an unsigned JWT via id_token_hint to influence the consumed identity/claims without proper signature verification.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_hint_none_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_hint_none_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted an unsigned id_token_hint (alg=none) in a way that allowed progress without real authentication, indicating proof integrity failure.

sequence_description: Token exchange scope escalation: obtain a baseline token with limited scopes, then attempt RFC8693 token exchange requesting expanded scopes (groups/profile/federated:id) and verify Dex does not mint a token with extra claims beyond upstream intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_scope_escalate_exchange_login_status >= 400 OR user_scope_escalate_exchange_groups is None
Evaluation: (user_scope_escalate_exchange_login_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (user_scope_escalate_exchange_groups=['authors'] is None → False)
Implication: Dex minted an exchanged token that appears to include groups (or otherwise succeeded) when the upstream intent was limited to openid email; token exchange should be rejected or must not add claims beyond original scope.

sequence_description: Attempt to bypass upstream intent by exchanging a limited-scope subject_token for a token that includes groups/profile claims; verify exchanged token does not contain extra claims (or exchange is rejected). Includes a control exchange first.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_limited_exchange_attack_login_status >= 400 OR user_limited_exchange_attack_groups is None
Evaluation: (user_limited_exchange_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (user_limited_exchange_attack_groups=['authors'] is None → False)
Implication: Token exchange minted a token with groups claim from a limited-scope upstream intent (openid email), indicating scope/authorization escalation

sequence_description: Attempt cross-client audience escalation using dynamic audience scope in token exchange; verify exchange is rejected or does not grant elevated audience-bound permissions. Includes two identities to ensure behavior is not user-specific.
description: Server returned HTTP 500 on token_exchange (auth_as=user_a_cross_aud_exchange): {"error":"server_error"}. Login endpoints must not return 5xx for any input.
